data.name: Apps_ScanOrphansExplainMessage
data.value:
An "orphan" is a Simpan Fail in your cloud Storan that no Aplikasi on this PC still references - left behind when a Simpan was renamed, an Aplikasi was uninstalled, or a Segerak was interrupted. They take up space and can shadow newer saves on conflict.
This Imbas only reads your cloud listings; nothing is Dipadamkan. After the Imbas, each affected Aplikasi gets a "Review Orphans" button so you can inspect the Fail and decide whether to prune them.
Steam must be closed during the Imbas so an in-flight Muat naik can't be misread as an orphan. Continue?

data.name: Disclaimer_Intro
data.value: There used to be a scary screen here. That screen is gone now. Life is about choices. I mean, life is really about other people but that's a bit heavy for a Amaran screen. A former Amaran screen, even.

data.name: Disclaimer_HowItWorks
data.value: Cloud Redirect does very silly things that results in Steam Cloud operations being redirected towards a provider of your choice. If that provider is Google Drive specifically, you have access to Google Drive Fail versioning. You can pull down older versions of saves.

data.name: Disclaimer_TrackRecord
data.value: In practice, this makes Cloud Redirect Mod very low risk. I've had maybe...three? reported incidents of data loss in a release build ever. Two were in extremely early versions and I was able to recover the data for the users. One was more recent, caused by a component that does not exist anymore and a network failure at the worst possible Masa & was not reported to me until days later, resulted in an hour of lost progress. I would have been able to recover the data, but the Pengguna progressed past that point before I was sent logs.

data.name: Disclaimer_ChoiceIntegrity
data.value: If you are worried about the integrity of your on disk saves most of Semua, this may not be the tool for you. It's been fine for me and for many others, but it may not suit you.

data.name: Disclaimer_ChoiceBackup
data.value: If your failure scenario is 'reinstalling Windows and forgetting to Sandaran Semua my saves/hardware failure/Permainan crashes and corrupts Simpan', CR can help.

data.name: Disclaimer_ChoiceMultiPC
data.value: If you want to play a Permainan across two (or more) different PCs, CR is the best way to do that. It's more reliable than anything else.
